Julien Pillot, a doctor of economics at the University of Nice, says that these platforms raise questions about the 'monetization of reality' and 'gamification.' He suggests that the media should ignore these cases as they do not influence public debate. However, studies have shown that these bets can influence elections, creating an 'oracle effect.' A case in point is the 2024 Romanian presidential election, where an anonymous investor spent over $2.5 million to influence the popularity of George Simion on Polymarket.
